world_type: 16 hand-written batched episodic toy worlds (6-channel obs, 3 actions, T 40-80) with present/absent/shuffled modes; one 2-population matching-pennies world
organism_type: batched scalar dataflow graph, 6 inputs + <=8 hidden + 3 outputs, 9 arithmetic ops, keep leak, recurrence, Hebbian plasticity on W1; 2 ticks per step
pressure_type: world reward structure (hidden state, delay, catastrophe, scarcity, death, coupling) plus substrate constraints (carrier exclusion, recurrent-edge tax, mutational subsidy, jitter)
ruler_type: world-reward thresholds; present vs absent vs shuffled behavioural contrasts; node ablation then edge/SCC-aware carrier cuts; mechanical gates A/B/C; time-to-threshold
scale: P=128, G=120, 4 train episodes/gen, 32 held-out; ~330 GA runs over 3 cycles at 3-10 seeds; ~13 ms per 128-organism episode
major_limitations: worlds demand one bit; solved by a two-edge output self-loop
only three possible cross-step channels by construction
held-out selection defect D1 still in search.run
cycle-0/1 control readings never re-derived without D1
no crossover, novelty or QD; no parsimony; keep clipped at 0.98
notable_campaigns: Cycle 2 attack-the-mechanism (substitution; basin-width post hoc; gate C shut)
